jobs.title: Head of Neurodegeneration, Translational Medicine
jobs.description:
Job Description Summary
#LI-Hybrid
Internal job title: Executive Director
Location: Basel, Switzerland

As the Head of Neurodegeneration within Translational Medicine, you will serve as a senior scientific and strategic leader responsible for shaping and delivering the translational strategy for neurodegenerative therapeutic programs. You will provide expert guidance bridging research, early clinical development, and biomarker/experimental medicine innovation to advance assets from discovery through proof-of-concept and into full development.

In addition, you will lead or integrate global, cross-functional teams to design, implement, and execute cutting-edge translational strategies, and act as an influential thought partner in neurodegenerative disease biology, clinical development, and emerging therapeutic modalities.

Job Description
Key Responsibilities:

Strategic Leadership & Scientific Direction

• Define and oversee the long-term translational strategy for the Neurodegeneration Pillar, ensuring scientific excellence and alignment with broader BR and TM organizational priorities.

• Serve as a senior advisor and thought leader within neurodegeneration disorders, leveraging deep specialty expertise to inform program design, biomarker strategy, and patient-relevant endpoints.

Program & Portfolio Leadership

• Lead global translational teams across Phase I–IIa (“Discovery” through TDP), driving implementation of high‑quality development strategies in single or multiple neurodegeneration indications.

• Represent TM on global program teams (GPT) and decision boards, ensuring that neurodegeneration programs meet quality, regulatory, and differentiation objectives.

Translational & Clinical Development Excellence

• Lead the design and execution of First‑in‑Human (FIH) and Phase IIa studies, working collaboratively with clinical, regulatory, biomarker, and profiling partners.

• Leads the creation of clinical components of key documents e.g., Clinical Trial Protocols (CTPs), Investigator’s Brochures, Clinical Study Reports (CSRs), regulatory documents etc. with high levels of quality and consistency

Leadership of People, Culture, and Matrix Teams

• Serve as a culture champion, promoting empowerment, innovation, and collaboration across TM and broader BR organizations.

• Mentor and develop scientific talent across translational and clinical functions.

External Impact & Partnerships

• Lead interactions with external stakeholders (e.g., regulatory authorities, key opinion leaders, data monitoring committees, advisory boards etc.) and internal NVS stakeholders

• Contribute to opportunity assessments and due diligence for neurodegeneration and adjacent therapeutic areas.

Governance, Compliance & Documentation

Essential Requirements:

• MD and PhD required with clinical subspecialty training in neurological diseases with deep expertise in neurodegeneration disorders

• A minimum of 10+ years of extensive experience in translational medicine, early clinical development, or experimental therapeutics.

• Demonstrated success leading complex global programs and cross-functional scientific teams.

• Proven ability to shape development strategies, execute early clinical studies, and influence regulatory/packages supporting differentiation.

• Experience working in pharmaceutical/biotech company strongly preferred.

Desirable Requirements:

• Direct people management experience

Accessibility and Accommodation:
Novartis is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodation to all individuals. If, because of a medical condition or disability, you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the recruitment process, or in order to receive more detailed information about the essential functions of a position, please send an e-mail to inclusion.switzerland@novartis.com and let us know the nature of your request and your contact information. Please include the job requisition number in your message.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Descrizione del lavoro Riepilogo #LI-Hybrid Titolo del lavoro interno: Direttore esecutivo Luogo: Basilea, Svizzera

Come responsabile della neurodegenerazione nell'ambito della Medicina Traduttiva, sarà un leader scientifico e strategico senior responsabile della formazione e della fornitura della strategia di traduzione per i programmi terapeutici neurodegenerativi. Fornirai una guida specializzata per la ricerca ponte, lo sviluppo clinico precoce e l'innovazione biomarcatore/medicina sperimentale per far progredire i beni dalla scoperta attraverso la prova di concetto e in pieno sviluppo.

Inoltre, guiderai o integrerai team globali e interfunzionali per progettare, implementare ed eseguire strategie di traduzione all'avanguardia e fungere da partner di pensiero influente nella biologia delle malattie neurodegenerative, nello sviluppo clinico e nelle modalità terapeutiche emergenti.

Responsabilità chiave

Direzione strategica e scientifica

- Definire e supervisionare la strategia traslazionale a lungo termine per il pilastro di neurodegenerazione, garantendo l'eccellenza scientifica e l'allineamento con le più ampie priorità organizzative BR e TM. - Serve come consulente senior e leader del pensiero nei disturbi neurodegenerazionali, sfruttando profonda competenza specialistica per informare la progettazione del programma, la strategia di biomarcatore e gli endpoint rilevanti per il paziente.

Leadership di & portafoglio di programmi

- Leader team di traduzione globale in tutta la fase I.IIa (Discovery. attraverso TDP), guidando l'implementazione di strategie di sviluppo di alta qualità in singole o multiple indicazioni di neurodegenerazione. - Rappresentare TM in team di programma globale (GPT) e comitati decisionali, garantendo che i programmi di neurodegenerazione soddisfino obiettivi di qualità, regolamentazione e differenziazione.

Eccellenza di sviluppo traslazionale e clinico

- Guidare la progettazione e l'esecuzione di studi First-in-Human (FIH) e di studi di fase IIa, lavorando in collaborazione con partner clinici, normativi, biomarcatori e affrancatori. - Guida la creazione di componenti clinici di documenti chiave, ad esempio protocolli di sperimentazione clinica (CTP), investigatore. Brochures, Rapporti di studio clinico (CSR), documenti normativi ecc. con alti livelli di qualità e coerenza

Leadership delle squadre di persone, cultura e matrice

- Se 'I' come campione culturale, promuovendo l'empowerment, l'innovazione e la collaborazione tra TM e organizzazioni BR più ampie. - Mentor e sviluppare talento scientifico attraverso funzioni traduzionali e cliniche.

Impatto esterno e partenariati

- Interazioni con le parti interessate esterne (ad esempio, autorità di regolamentazione, opinion leader chiave, comitati di monitoraggio dei dati, consigli consultivi ecc.) e parti interessate interne alla NVS - Contribuire a valutazioni delle opportunità e a due diligence per la neurodegenerazione e aree terapeutiche adiacenti.

Governance, conformità e documentazione

Requisiti essenziali

- MD e PhD richiesti con formazione clinica subspecialy in malattie del neurologico con profonda esperienza nei disturbi neurodegenerazionali - Un minimo di 10+ anni di esperienza estesa in medicina traslazionale, sviluppo clinico precoce, o terapie sperimentali. - Successo dimostrato leader complessi programmi globali e team scientifici cross-funzionali. - Capacità di provare a modellare strategie di sviluppo, eseguire studi clinici precoci, e influenzare normative / pacchetti che supportano la differenziazione. - L'esperienza di lavoro in azienda farmaceutica / biotech fortemente preferito.

Requisiti desiderabili

- Esperienza diretta di gestione delle persone

Accessibilità e Alloggio

Lavorare con e fornire un alloggio ragionevole a tutti gli individui. Se, a causa di una condizione medica o di disabilità, è necessario un alloggio ragionevole per qualsiasi parte del processo di reclutamento, o per ricevere informazioni più dettagliate sulle funzioni essenziali di una posizione, si prega di inviare una e-mail a include.switzerland@novartis.com e di farci sapere la natura della vostra richiesta e le informazioni di contatto. Si prega di includere il numero di lavoro di disclaimer nel vostro messaggio.

Jobbeschreibung Zusammenfassung #LI-Hybrid Interner Jobtitel: Geschäftsführer Standort: Basel, Schweiz

Als Leiter der Neurodegeneration in der Translational Medicine sind Sie als wissenschaftlicher und strategischer Leiter für die Gestaltung und Umsetzung der translationalen Strategie für neurodegenerative Therapieprogramme verantwortlich. Sie bieten Ihnen fachkundige Beratung, die Forschung, die frühe klinische Entwicklung und die Biomarker/Experimental Medicine Innovation überbrücken, um die Vermögenswerte von der Entdeckung über Proof-of-Concept bis hin zur vollständigen Entwicklung zu fördern.

Darüber hinaus führen oder integrieren Sie globale, funktionsübergreifende Teams, um innovative Übersetzungsstrategien zu entwerfen, umzusetzen und umzusetzen und als einflussreicher Denkpartner in der neurodegenerativen Krankheitsbiologie, der klinischen Entwicklung und den sich abzeichnenden therapeutischen Modalitäten zu agieren.

Wichtige Aufgaben

Strategische Führung und wissenschaftliche Leitung

- Definieren und überwachen Sie die langfristige Übersetzungsstrategie für die Neurodegeneration Pillar, die wissenschaftliche Exzellenz und Ausrichtung mit breiteren BR und TM Organisationsprioritäten gewährleistet. - Als Senior Advisor und Think Leader in Neurodegeneration Störungen, die Nutzung von tiefen Spezialwissen, um Programmdesign, Biomarker-Strategie und Patienten-relevante Endpunkte zu informieren.

Programm & Portfolio Führung

- Führende globale Übersetzungsteams in Phase I–IIa (Discovery, through TDP), die die Umsetzung hochwertiger Entwicklungsstrategien in Einzel- oder Mehrfach-Neurodegenerations-Indikationen vorantreiben. - Vertretung von TM in globalen Programmteams (GPT) und Entscheidungsforen, um sicherzustellen, dass Neurodegenerationsprogramme Qualitätsziele, Regulierung und Differenzierung erreichen.

Exzellenz für Translationale und Klinische Entwicklung

- Leiten Sie die Konzeption und Durchführung von First-in-Human (FIH) und Phase IIa Studien, die in Zusammenarbeit mit klinischen, regulatorischen, Biomarker und Profiling-Partnern durchgeführt werden. - Leiten Sie die Erstellung klinischer Komponenten von Schlüsseldokumenten, z.B. Clinical Trial Protocols (CTPs), Investigator, Broschüren, Clinical Study Reports (CSRs), regulatorische Dokumente usw. mit hoher Qualität und Konsistenz

Führung von Menschen, Kultur und Matrix Teams

- Als Kultur-Champion dienen, Förderung von Empowerment, Innovation und Zusammenarbeit in TM und breiteren BR-Organisationen. - Mentor und entwickeln wissenschaftliche Talente über translationale und klinische Funktionen.

Externe Auswirkungen und Partnerschaften

- Leitaktionen mit externen Stakeholdern (z.B. Regulierungsbehörden, Schlüsselakteure für Stellungnahmen, Datenüberwachungsausschüsse, Beiräte usw.) und internen NVS-Stakeholdern - Beitrag zu Chancenbewertungen und Due Diligence für Neurodegeneration und angrenzende Therapiebereiche.

Governance, Compliance und Dokumentation

Grundlegende Anforderungen

- MD und PhD mit klinischer Unterspezialisierung in neurologischen Erkrankungen mit tiefer Expertise in neurodegenerationsbedingten Störungen erforderlich - Mindestens 10 Jahre umfassende Erfahrung in der Translationalmedizin, der frühen klinischen Entwicklung oder experimentellen Therapeutika. - Vorgestellter Erfolg führenden komplexen globalen Programmen und funktionsübergreifenden wissenschaftlichen Teams. - Bewährte Fähigkeit, Entwicklungsstrategien zu gestalten, frühzeitige klinische Studien durchzuführen und Einfluss auf regulatorische / Pakete unterstützende Differenzierung. - Erfahrung in Pharma / Biotech Unternehmen stark bevorzugt.

Wünschenswerte Anforderungen

- Direkte Menschen Management Erfahrung

Zugänglichkeit und Unterkunft

Novartis verpflichtet sich, mit allen Personen zusammenzuarbeiten und angemessene Unterkünfte zu bieten. Wenn Sie aufgrund eines medizinischen Zustandes oder einer Behinderung eine angemessene Unterkunft für einen Teil des Einstellungsprozesses benötigen oder um detailliertere Informationen über die wesentlichen Funktionen einer Position zu erhalten, senden Sie bitte eine E-Mail an include.switzerland@novartis.com und lassen Sie uns die Art Ihrer Anfrage und Ihre Kontaktdaten wissen. Bitte geben Sie die Nummer der Stellenannahme in Ihre Nachricht ein.

Description de l'emploi Résumé #LI-Hybrid Titre de l'emploi interne : Directeur exécutif Lieu : Bâle, Suisse

En tant que chef de la neurodégénérescence en médecine translationnelle, vous serez un chef de file scientifique et stratégique principal responsable de la conception et de la prestation de la stratégie translationnelle pour les programmes thérapeutiques neurodégénératifs. Vous fournirez des conseils d'experts qui permettront de faire la transition entre la recherche, le développement clinique précoce et l'innovation en biomarqueur/médecine expérimentale afin de faire progresser les atouts de la découverte par la preuve de concept et de le développer pleinement.

En outre, vous dirigerez ou intégrerez des équipes globales et interfonctionnelles pour concevoir, mettre en œuvre et exécuter des stratégies translationnelles de pointe et agir comme un partenaire de pensée influent dans la biologie des maladies neurodégénératives, le développement clinique et les nouvelles modalités thérapeutiques.

Principales responsabilités

Leadership stratégique et orientation scientifique

- Définir et superviser la stratégie translationnelle à long terme pour le pilier de la neurodégénérescence, en assurant l'excellence scientifique et l'alignement sur les priorités organisationnelles plus vastes des BR et des TM. - Servir de conseiller principal et de chef de file de la pensée dans les troubles de neurodégénérescence, en tirant parti de l'expertise spécialisée profonde pour éclairer la conception des programmes, la stratégie de biomarqueur et les paramètres pertinents pour le patient.

Leadership des programmes et du portefeuille

- Diriger les équipes de traduction mondiales de la phase I–IIa (,Découverte, par le biais du PDT), en vue de la mise en oeuvre de stratégies de développement de haute qualité dans des indications de neurodégénérescence unique ou multiple. - Représenter les TG dans les équipes de programme mondial (EPG) et les conseils de décision, en veillant à ce que les programmes de neurodégénérescence répondent aux objectifs de qualité, de réglementation et de différenciation.

Excellence en traduction et en développement clinique

- Diriger la conception et l'exécution des études sur les premiers sujets humains (FIH) et sur les études de phase IIa, en collaboration avec des partenaires cliniques, réglementaires, biomarqueurs et de profilage. - Diriger la création de composantes cliniques de documents clés, p. ex. protocoles d'essais cliniques (PTC), chercheurs, brochures, rapports d'études cliniques (REC), documents réglementaires, etc., avec des niveaux élevés de qualité et d'uniformité

Leadership des équipes des gens, de la culture et de la matrice

- Servir de champion de la culture, promouvoir l'autonomisation, l'innovation et la collaboration entre les organisations de TM et les organisations de BR plus vastes. - Mentor et développer les talents scientifiques dans toutes les fonctions de traduction et de clinique.

Impact externe et partenariats

- Mener des interactions avec des intervenants externes (p. ex., les autorités de réglementation, les principaux leaders d'opinion, les comités de surveillance des données, les conseils consultatifs, etc.) et les intervenants internes du VAN - Contribuer aux évaluations des possibilités et à la diligence raisonnable pour la neurodégénérescence et les domaines thérapeutiques adjacents.

Gouvernance, conformité et documentation

Exigences essentielles

- MD et doctorat requis avec une formation clinique de sous-spécialité dans les maladies neurologiques ayant une expertise profonde dans les troubles neurodégénératifs - Un minimum de 10 ans et plus d'expérience approfondie en médecine translationnelle, développement clinique précoce ou thérapeutique expérimentale. - Succès démontré leader de programmes mondiaux complexes et d'équipes scientifiques interfonctionnelles. - Capacité prouvée de façonner des stratégies de développement, d'exécuter des études cliniques précoces et d'influencer les règlements/paquets favorisant la différenciation. - Expérience dans la société pharmaceutique/biotech fortement préférée.

Exigences souhaitables

- Expérience de gestion directe des personnes

Accessibilité et hébergement

Si, en raison d'une maladie ou d'une déficience, vous avez besoin d'un aménagement raisonnable pour toute partie du processus de recrutement ou pour recevoir des renseignements plus détaillés sur les fonctions essentielles d'un poste, veuillez envoyer un courriel à include.switzerland@novartis.com et nous faire savoir la nature de votre demande et vos coordonnées. Veuillez inclure le numéro de la demande d'emploi dans votre message.

Compétences D

Job Description Summary
This position can be based remotely anywhere in the U.S. Please note that this role would not provide relocation as a result. The expectation of working hours and travel (domestic and/or international) will be defined by the Hiring Manager.

Job Description
The Strategy, Platforms & Transformation team is dedicated to enabling improved decision-making at Novartis by leveraging data and advanced analytics capabilities to generate actionable insights that drive business growth. We work within the US business, bringing insights and challenging ideas to empower smarter, data-driven decision-making. This role is crucial in driving AI transformation by bringing the best in AI and tech to unlock opportunities for growth and improve patient outcomes.

The Executive Director, AI Forward Deployed Engineering Lead will lead the engineering delivery of agentic AI solutions embedded within business functions, with responsibility across solution architecture, development, implementation, operations, and continuous improvement. This role will be critical to transforming existing processes, products, and services into agentic AI products and intelligent workflows by partnering closely with business teams to design and deploy practical, scalable solutions that address high value use cases. The ideal candidate will bring strong engineering leadership, solution orientation, and cross functional execution skills to guide the development of fit for purpose AI applications, oversee deployment into real world operating environments, and ensure solutions are reliable, maintainable, and aligned with enterprise standards. Working closely with product leaders, platform teams, data partners, business stakeholders, and transformation leaders, this role will help accelerate AI adoption, drive measurable business impact, and ensure solutions continuously evolve based on operational feedback and emerging needs.

Major Accountabilities

• Define and lead the engineering strategy, delivery model, and execution approach for forward deployed agentic AI solutions across business functions.

• Oversee the design, development, implementation, and ongoing support of AI solutions that transform business processes and products into agentic workflows.

• Partner directly with business stakeholders, product teams, and domain experts to identify requirements, shape technical solutions, and ensure adoption in operational environments.

• Lead engineering teams in building, deploying, and maintaining scalable, reliable, and user centered AI applications aligned with enterprise architecture and standards.

• Drive integration of AI solutions with existing systems, data sources, workflows, and operational processes to enable effective end to end execution.

• Establish engineering practices, support models, and feedback loops that promote quality, reliability, operational performance, and continuous improvement.

• Coordinate closely with platform, data, security, and infrastructure teams to ensure solutions leverage shared capabilities and comply with enterprise requirements.

• Communicate engineering priorities, solution progress, business impact, risks, and resource needs to senior leadership and key stakeholders.

Essential Requirements:

• Bachelor degree required and advanced degree preferred, ideally in business, engineering, computer science, data science, or a related field.

• 15 plus years of progressive product management experience, including significant leadership over senior product leaders, with a strong track record of defining and scaling enterprise level product strategy and execution.

• Deep expertise in AI driven product management, including experience bringing innovative data, machine learning, and generative AI products from concept to commercialization in complex enterprise environments.

• Proven people leadership and organizational development capability, with experience leading directors and senior product teams, building

Job Description Summary
#LI-Hybrid
Location: Basel, Switzerland

As a Translational Medicine Expert (TME) you will provide medical and scientific expertise and leadership to:
• Drive success of early global programs, develop and implement strategies to achieve Transition Decision Point (TDP)
• Drive success of late global programs by developing and implementing strategies, which lead to clinical pharmacology and profiling packages that meet regulatory requirements and support differentiated and competitive drug labeling.
• Support Translational Research in developing new indications, endpoints and biomarkers, using in vitro, in vivo, or in silico methods.
• Provide scientific expert assessments and support for in-licensing opportunities, including due diligences.

Job Description
Key Responsibilities:
Early clinical projects (Phase I / II, “Discovery”):
Develop, in collaboration with the dermatology TA and work with teams to carry out, strategies for the Translational Medicine component of drug development projects from Research to TDP in single or multiple indications, including post-indication expansion (PIE) projects.

Late-stage clinical projects (post-TDP, “Profiling”):
In collaboration with the dermatology TA Head: Act as a key leader in developing the Ph2-3 and post-approval profiling strategy for drug programs, representing TMDP on Global Project Team (GPT) along with other TM line functions. Provide support for dose selection, study design and other clinical pharmacology matters throughout the development cycle. Oversee conduct and interpretation of studies prioritized by the to support the pivotal trials, such as special populations, drug-drug interactions, mechanism of action assessments, Pediatric Investigational Plan, etc.

Translational Research (TR; indication seeking, endpoint and biomarker development):
In collaboration with the dermatology TA Head, BR Research scientists, other TM line functions (BMD, CS&I, PCS, PKS), develop strategies to identify initial or expansion (PIE) indications, and to obtain sufficient evidence to fund these ideas.

Business Development and Licensing (BD&L; in-licensing and out licensing compounds):
Participate on BD&L teams as the TM representative.

General responsibilities:

• Responsible for clinical monitoring and integrated safety data review during and after the live phase of a study.

• Provides medical and scientific leadership and expertise to all line functions on the study team.

• Represent clinical Translational Medicine aspects to Health Authorities and other stakeholders (e.g. payers, patient advocacy groups).

• Oversee publication strategy for TM studies; lead writing of scientific publications; present study results externally where appropriate

Leadership:

• Lead study-specific teams/ clinical trial teams in partnership with other line functions.

• Lead BR-sub-team(s) on Global Project Teams for late-phase programs

• Collaborate closely with other TM (especially CS&I) and non-TM (especially Project Management) line functions to ensure operational excellence, continued urgency, and close attention to timelines, costs, and subject burden in balance with high scientific standards and innovation

Essential Requirements:

• Doctoral degree, MD

• Board certified Dermatologist

• Preferably Ph.D. within dermatology/immunology

• At least 5 years’ experience in a pharmaceutical/biotech company, CRO, or academic medical center, or related experience

• Innovation: Seeks out new clinical discovery opportunities and approaches to reach TDP

• Recognized expert in field, driving success for individual studies and projects; respected by colleagues across R&D, Development, and externally

• Fluent oral and written English

Benefits & Rewards
At Novartis, we’re committed to reimagining medicine together - and rewarding the people who make it happen.

Expected Annual Base Salary Range for role:

• 122,500.00 - 227,500.00 CHF Annua

Descrizione del lavoro Riepilogo #LI-Hybrid Ubicazione: Basel, Switzerland

Come esperto di medicina traslazionale (TME) fornirete competenze mediche e scientifiche e leadership per: - Guidare il successo dei primi programmi globali, sviluppare e attuare strategie per raggiungere Transition Decision Point (TDP) - Guidare il successo dei programmi di fine globale sviluppando e implementando strategie, che portano alla farmacologia clinica e pacchetti di affrancatura che soddisfano i requisiti normativi e supportano l'etichettatura differenziata e competitiva dei farmaci. - Supporto Ricerca traslazionale nello sviluppo di nuove indicazioni, endpoint e biomarcatori, utilizzando metodi in vitro, in vivo o in silico.

- fornire valutazioni scientifiche di esperti e sostegno per le opportunità di licenza, comprese le dovute diligence.

Descrizione del lavoro

Responsabilità chiave: Progetti clinici precoci (fase I / II, Discovery.): - Sviluppare, in collaborazione con la dermatologia TA e lavorare con team per effettuare, strategie per la componente Medicina Traduttiva dei progetti di sviluppo di droga dalla Ricerca al TDP in singole o multiple indicazioni, compresi i progetti di espansione post-indicazione (PIE).

Progetti clinici in fase di Late (post-TDP,.Profilo.): - In collaborazione con la dermatologia TA Head: Agire come leader chiave nello sviluppo della strategia Ph2-3 e post-approvazione di ragonaggio per i programmi antidroga, rappresentando TMDP sul Global Project Team (GPT) insieme ad altre funzioni della linea TM. - Fornire supporto per la selezione della dose, la progettazione dello studio e altre questioni di farmacologia clinica durante il ciclo di sviluppo.

- Sopravvivere la condotta e l'interpretazione degli studi prioritarizzati dalla sperimentazione pilota, quali popolazioni speciali, interazioni farmaco-farmaco, meccanismi di valutazione dell'azione, Piano di indagine pediatrica, ecc.

Ricerca traslazionale (TR; ricerca di indicazioni, endpoint e sviluppo di biomarcatori): - In collaborazione con la responsabile della dermatologia TA, BR Research scientists, altre funzioni della linea TM (BMD, CS&I, PCS, PKS), sviluppare strategie per identificare le indicazioni iniziali o di espansione (PIE) e per ottenere prove sufficienti per finanziare queste idee.

Business Development and Licensing (BD&L; componenti per la licenza in licenza e fuori): - Partecipa alle squadre BD&L in qualità di rappresentante del TM.

Responsabilità generali: - Responsabile del monitoraggio clinico e della revisione integrata dei dati di sicurezza durante e dopo la fase in cui si svolge uno studio. - Fornisce la leadership medica e scientifica e la competenza a tutte le funzioni di linea del gruppo di studio. - Rappresentare aspetti clinici della medicina traslazionale alle autorità sanitarie e ad altre parti interessate (ad esempio i contribuenti, i gruppi di advocacy dei pazienti). - Superare la strategia di pubblicazione per gli studi sulla TM; scrivere testate scientifiche; presentare i risultati dello studio esternamente, ove opportuno.

Leadership: - Lead team di studio specifici/squadre di studi clinici in collaborazione con altre funzioni di linea. - Lead BR-sub-team (s) sui team di progetto globali per programmi in fase avanzata - Collaborazione strettamente con altre funzioni di linea TM (in particolare CS&I) e non-TM (in particolare Project Management) per garantire l'eccellenza operativa, la continuità dell'urgenza e la stretta attenzione alle linee temporali, ai costi e agli oneri soggettivi in equilibrio con elevati standard scientifici e innovazione

Requisiti essenziali: - Dottorato, MD - Dermatologa certificata da consiglio - Preferibilmente Ph.D. in dermatologia/immunologia - Almeno 5 anni. esperienza in una società farmaceutica/biotech, CRO, o centro medico accademico, o esperienza correlata - Innovazione: Cerca nuove opportunità di scoperta clinica e approcci per raggiungere TDP - Esperto riconosciuto sul campo, guidando il successo per studi e progetti individuali; rispettato dai colleghi in tutto R&D, Sviluppo, ed esternamente - Fluente orale e scritto inglese

Vantaggi e premi In Novartis, ci siamo impegnati a reimmaginare la medicina insieme e a ricompensare le persone che la fanno accadere.

Range annuale di base previsto per il ruolo: - 122,500.00 - 227,500.00 CHF Annua

Jobbeschreibung Zusammenfassung #LI-Hybrid Ort: Basel, Schweiz

Als Translational Medicine Expert (TME) bieten Sie medizinische und wissenschaftliche Expertise und Führung bei: - Führen Sie den Erfolg von frühen globalen Programmen, entwickeln und implementieren Sie Strategien, um Transition Decision Point (TDP) zu erreichen - Antrieb Erfolg von späten globalen Programmen durch die Entwicklung und Umsetzung von Strategien, die zu klinischen Pharmakologie und Profiling-Pakete führen, die regulatorische Anforderungen erfüllen und differenzierte und wettbewerbsfähige Arzneimittelkennzeichnung unterstützen. - Unterstützung Translational Research bei der Entwicklung neuer Indikationen, Endpunkte und Biomarker, mit In-vitro, in vivo oder in Silico-Methoden.

- Bereitstellung wissenschaftlicher Expertenbewertungen und Unterstützung für die Lizenzvergabe, einschließlich Due Diligences.

Aufgabenbeschreibung

Wichtige Aufgaben: Frühe klinische Projekte (Phase I / II,,Discovery,): - Entwickeln Sie in Zusammenarbeit mit der Dermatologie TA und arbeiten Sie mit Teams an der Durchführung, Strategien für die Translational Medicine Komponente von Medikamentenentwicklungsprojekten von Forschung bis TDP in einzelnen oder mehreren Indikationen, einschließlich Post-Indikations-Erweiterung (PIE) Projekte.

Spätphasen-Klinische Projekte (nach TDP,, ), : - In Zusammenarbeit mit der Dermatologie TA Head: Act als ein wichtiger Führer bei der Entwicklung der Ph2-3 und Post-Genehmigung Profiling-Strategie für Arzneimittel-Programme, die TMDP auf Global Project Team (GPT) zusammen mit anderen TM-Linie Funktionen. - Unterstützung für die Dosisauswahl, Studiendesign und andere klinische Pharmakologie Fragen während des gesamten Entwicklungszyklus.

- Überwachen Sie die Durchführung und Interpretation von Studien, die von der Unterstützung der zentralen Studien priorisiert wurden, wie spezielle Populationen, Arzneimittel-Drogen-Interaktionen, Mechanismus der Wirkungsbewertungen, Pediatric Investigation Plan, etc.

Translational Research (TR; Indikationssuche, Endpunkt- und Biomarkerentwicklung): - In Zusammenarbeit mit dem Dermatologie-TA-Leiter, BR-Forschungswissenschaftlern, anderen TM-Line-Funktionen (BMD, CS&I, PCS, PKS), entwickeln Strategien zur Identifizierung von Initial- oder Expansions-Indikationen (PIE) und zur Erlangung ausreichender Nachweise, um diese Ideen zu finanzieren.

Business Development and Licensing (BD&L; In-Lizenzierung und Ausverkauf von Lizenzierungs-Compounds): - Nehmen Sie als TM-Vertreter an BD&L-Teams teil.

Allgemeine Verantwortung: - Verantwortlich für die klinische Überwachung und integrierte Sicherheitsdatenüberprüfung während und nach der Live-Phase einer Studie. - Bietet medizinische und wissenschaftliche Führung und Expertise für alle Leitungsfunktionen im Studienteam. - Vertreten klinische Translational Medicine Aspekte für Gesundheitsbehörden und andere Stakeholder (z.B. Zahler, Patienten-Advocacy-Gruppen). - Überwachen Sie die Publikationsstrategie für TM-Studien; Leadwriting von wissenschaftlichen Publikationen; präsentieren Sie Studienergebnisse extern, wenn angemessen

Führung: - Leitungsteams/ klinische Testteams in Partnerschaft mit anderen Leitungsfunktionen. - Leitungsteams für BR-Teilteams im Global Project Teams für Spätphasenprogramme - enge Zusammenarbeit mit anderen TM (insbesondere CS&I) und Nicht-TM (insbesondere Projektmanagement)-Linienfunktionen, um operative Exzellenz, anhaltende Dringlichkeit und die Aufmerksamkeit auf Zeitlinien, Kosten und Themenlast im Einklang mit hohen wissenschaftlichen Standards und Innovationen zu gewährleisten

Grundlegende Voraussetzungen: - Doktorat, MD - Vorstand zertifiziert Dermatologe - Vorzugsweise Doktorat in der Dermatologie/Immunologie - Mindestens 5 Jahre, Erfahrung in einem Pharma-/Biotech-Unternehmen, CRO, oder akademische medizinische Zentrum, oder verwandte Erfahrung - Innovation: Suche nach neuen klinischen Entdeckungsmöglichkeiten und Ansätzen, um TDP zu erreichen - Erkannter Experte im Bereich, Antriebserfolg für einzelne Studien und Projekte; von Kollegen in Forschung und Entwicklung, Entwicklung und extern respektiert - Fluent oral und schriftlich Englisch

Vorteile & Belohnungen Bei Novartis sind wir verpflichtet, die Medizin zusammen neu zu gestalten - und die Menschen zu belohnen, die es geschehen lassen.

Description de l'emploi Résumé #LI-Hybrid Lieu: Bâle, Suisse

En tant qu'expert en médecine translationnelle, vous fournirez une expertise médicale et scientifique et un leadership pour : - favoriser la réussite des premiers programmes mondiaux, élaborer et mettre en oeuvre des stratégies pour atteindre le point de décision de transition (DPT) - favoriser la réussite des programmes mondiaux tardifs en élaborant et en mettant en oeuvre des stratégies qui mènent à la pharmacologie clinique et à des ensembles de profilage qui répondent aux exigences réglementaires et qui appuient l'étiquetage différencié et concurrentiel des médicaments. - appuyer la recherche translationnelle dans l'élaboration de nouvelles indications, critères et biomarqueurs, en utilisant des méthodes in vitro, in vivo ou silico.

- Fournir des évaluations scientifiques et un soutien pour les possibilités de licence, y compris des diligences raisonnables.

Description de l'emploi

Principales responsabilités : Projets cliniques précoces (phase I / II,, Découverte) : - Élaborer, en collaboration avec l'AT dermatologique et travailler avec des équipes pour réaliser, des stratégies pour la composante Médecine Translationnelle des projets de développement de médicaments de la recherche au PDT en une ou plusieurs indications, y compris des projets d'expansion post-Digération (EIP).

Projets cliniques en fin de cycle (après le PDT,,Profilage) : - En collaboration avec le responsable de l'AT de dermatologie : Agir comme chef de file dans l'élaboration de la stratégie de profilage des médicaments Ph2-3 et post-approbation, représentant le PDTG au sein de l'équipe de projet mondial (GPT) et d'autres fonctions de ligne de TG. - Fournir un soutien pour la sélection des doses, la conception des études et d'autres questions de pharmacologie clinique tout au long du cycle de développement.

- Superviser la conduite et l'interprétation des études prioritaires par les essais pivots, tels que les populations spéciales, les interactions drogues-médicaments, le mécanisme d'évaluation des mesures, le Plan d'investigation pédiatrique, etc.

Recherche translationnelle (TR; recherche d'indications, développement de paramètres et de biomarqueurs) : - En collaboration avec le chef de l'AT dermatologique, les chercheurs en BR, d'autres fonctions de ligne de TM (BMD, CS&I, PCS, PKS), élaborer des stratégies pour identifier les indications initiales ou d'expansion (EIP) et obtenir des preuves suffisantes pour financer ces idées.

Développement des entreprises et délivrance de licences (BD&L; composés d'autorisation et de délivrance de licences) : - Participer aux équipes de BD&L en tant que représentant du TM.

Responsabilités générales : - Responsable de la surveillance clinique et de l'examen intégré des données sur l'innocuité pendant et après la phase de vie d'une étude. - Dirige et experte médicalement et scientifiquement toutes les fonctions de l'équipe d'étude. - Représenter les aspects cliniques de la médecine translationnelle aux autorités sanitaires et aux autres intervenants (p. ex., les années 006 et les groupes de défense des patients). - Superviser la stratégie de publication des études sur les TM; diriger la rédaction des publications scientifiques; présenter les résultats de l'étude de l'extérieur, le cas échéant.

Leadership : - Équipes et équipes d'essais cliniques qui sont chargées de diriger des études particulières en partenariat avec d'autres fonctions de la ligne. - Sous-équipes de projet mondial - Collaborez étroitement avec d'autres fonctions de la ligne TM (en particulier CS et I) et non MC (en particulier la gestion de projet) afin d'assurer l'excellence opérationnelle, l'urgence continue et une attention étroite aux délais, aux coûts et au fardeau des sujets en équilibre avec des normes scientifiques élevées et l'innovation

Exigences essentielles : - Doctorat, MD - Dermatologue certifié par le conseil - Doctorat de préférence en dermatologie/immunologie - Au moins 5 ans d'expérience dans une entreprise pharmaceutique/biotech, un centre de recherche ou un centre médical universitaire, ou expérience connexe - Innovation : recherche de nouvelles possibilités de découverte clinique et de nouvelles approches pour atteindre le PDT - Expert reconnu en matière de recherche, qui a permis de réussir des études et des projets individuels; respecté par des collègues de R-D, de Développement et externe - Anglais oral et écrit

Avantages et récompenses Chez Novartis, nous sommes déterminés à recréer la médecine ensemble - et à récompenser les gens qui la rendent possible.

Job Description Summary
Job Title: Director & Group Head (AI Systems & Scale)
#LI-Hybrid
Location: Basel, Switzerland
Relocation Support: This role is based in Basel, Switzerland. Novartis is unable to offer relocation support: please only apply if accessible.

Novartis has embraced a bold strategy to drive a company-wide digital transformation. Our objective is to position Novartis as an industry leader by proactively adopting digital technologies that foster innovative approaches to hasten drug discovery and development. By utilizing both internal and external R&D data with the power of data science, predictive models, generative AI, and machine learning, our objective is to identify new targets, create more effective therapeutic molecules, better predict drug pharmacokinetics and safety risks, refine clinical trial design, and significantly shorten development cycles. The AI4R team leads Novartis Biomedical Research (BR) in exploring and applying advanced AI and ML methodologies to generate novel drug discovery insights, and to speed and improve drug discovery efficiency whilst focusing on patients’ needs.

AI4R partners with drug discovery teams, raises the level of AI expertise across Biomedical Research (BR) and ensures that BR science keeps up with the rapidly evolving ecosystem of AI technologies by connecting with AI leaders in academia and industry.

This is a leadership role for the AI Systems & Scale group within AI4R and will be tasked with strong technical and project leadership, critical assessment and specialized deployment of compute, data, model, code and agentic platforms for rapid enablement and adoption of AI approaches, algorithms, models and workflows to maximize impact on key domains areas of biomedical research that will potentially lead to developing better drugs, faster.

Job Description
Step into a leadership role shaping the future of AI at scale, where advanced agentic systems and enterprise AI platforms transform how biomedical research is delivered. As Director & Group Head (AI-Systems & Scale), you will drive the design and deployment of next-Generation AI systems, enabling scientists to seamlessly leverage data, models, and intelligent workflows to accelerate drug discovery. You will lead high-performing engineering teams, define scalable architectures, and ensure AI solutions are robust, governed, and impactful—bringing innovative therapies closer to patients faster.

Key Responsibilities

• Define and lead the multi-year roadmap for scalable AI systems, platforms, and agentic architectures across research.

• Lead and scale multidisciplinary teams delivering production-grade AI systems and intelligent applications.

• Establish reference architectures for agentic systems, including orchestration, retrieval, memory, and human-in-the-loop controls.

• Build and standardize enterprise agentic platforms with reusable components, workflows, and evaluation frameworks.

• Define and enforce machine learning operations and large language model operations standards across AI systems development.

• Own agent quality and safety engineering, including guardrails, policy enforcement, and failure detection mechanisms.

• Drive scalable deployment strategies, ensuring performance, reliability, cost efficiency, and multi-tenant architecture.

• Define performance metrics linking system effectiveness to scientific outcomes, including accuracy, robustness, and efficiency.

• Partner with data, security, and platform teams to ensure governance, compliance, and responsible data usage.

• Drive cross-functional collaboration and portfolio management to prioritize high-impact AI system initiatives and reduce duplication.

Job Title: Director & Group Head (AI Systems & Scale)
#LI-Hybrid

Novartis has embraced a bold strategy to drive a company-wide digital transformation. Our objective is to position Novartis as an industry leader by proactively adopting digital technologies that foster innovative approaches to hasten drug discovery and development. By utilizing both internal and external R&D data with the power of data science, predictive models, generative AI, and machine learning, our objective is to identify new targets, create more effective therapeutic molecules, better predict drug pharmacokinetics and safety risks, refine clinical trial design, and significantly shorten development cycles. The AI4R team leads Novartis Biomedical Research (BR) in exploring and applying advanced AI and ML methodologies to generate novel drug discovery insights, and to speed and improve drug discovery efficiency whilst focusing on patients’ needs.

AI4R partners with drug discovery teams, raises the level of AI expertise across Biomedical Research (BR) and ensures that BR science keeps up with the rapidly evolving ecosystem of AI technologies by connecting with AI leaders in academia and industry.

This is a leadership role for the AI Systems & Scale group within AI4R and will be tasked with strong technical and project leadership, critical assessment and specialized deployment of compute, data, model, code and agentic platforms for rapid enablement and adoption of AI approaches, algorithms, models and workflows to maximize impact on key domains areas of biomedical research that will potentially lead to developing better drugs, faster.

Job Description
Step into a leadership role shaping the future of AI at scale, where advanced agentic systems and enterprise AI platforms transform how biomedical research is delivered. As Director & Group Head (AI-Systems & Scale), you will drive the design and deployment of next-Generation AI systems, enabling scientists to seamlessly leverage data, models, and intelligent workflows to accelerate drug discovery. You will lead high-performing engineering teams, define scalable architectures, and ensure AI solutions are robust, governed, and impactful—bringing innovative therapies closer to patients faster.

Key Responsibilities

• Define and lead the multi-year roadmap for scalable AI systems, platforms, and agentic architectures across research.

• Lead and scale multidisciplinary teams delivering production-grade AI systems and intelligent applications.

• Establish reference architectures for agentic systems, including orchestration, retrieval, memory, and human-in-the-loop controls.

• Build and standardize enterprise agentic platforms with reusable components, workflows, and evaluation frameworks.

• Define and enforce machine learning operations and large language model operations standards across AI systems development.

• Own agent quality and safety engineering, including guardrails, policy enforcement, and failure detection mechanisms.

• Drive scalable deployment strategies, ensuring performance, reliability, cost efficiency, and multi-tenant architecture.

• Define performance metrics linking system effectiveness to scientific outcomes, including accuracy, robustness, and efficiency.

• Partner with data, security, and platform teams to ensure governance, compliance, and responsible data usage.

• Drive cross-functional collaboration and portfolio management to prioritize high-impact AI system initiatives and reduce duplication.

Essential Requirements

• Demonstrated experience leading machine learning capability development initiatives across multiple drug discovery domains and teams.

• Strong experience applying machine learning across functional areas such as computati

Job Description Summary
Job Title: Director & Group Head (Applied AI)
#LI-Hybrid
Location: Basel, Switzerland
Relocation Support: This role is based in Basel, Switzerland. Novartis is unable to offer relocation support: please only apply if accessible.

Novartis has embraced a bold strategy to drive a company-wide digital transformation. Our objective is to position Novartis as an industry leader by proactively adopting digital technologies that foster innovative approaches to hasten drug discovery and development. By utilizing both internal and external R&D data with the power of data science, predictive models, generative AI, and machine learning, our objective is to identify new targets, create more effective therapeutic molecules, better predict drug pharmacokinetics and safety risks, refine clinical trial design, and significantly shorten development cycles. The AI4R team leads BR in exploring and applying advanced AI and ML methodologies to generate novel drug discovery insights, and to speed and improve drug discovery efficiency whilst focusing on patients’ needs.

AI4R partners with drug discovery teams, raises the level of AI expertise across Biomedical Research (BR) and ensures that BR science keeps up with the rapidly evolving ecosystem of AI technologies by connecting with AI leaders in academia and industry.

This leadership role for the  Applied AI group of AI4R will be tasked with strong technical, team and project leadership, aligning with biomedical subject matter experts to deeply understand ML opportunities in drug discovery, assessment of the model landscape, leading model benchmarking, and applying the right AI approaches, algorithms, models and workflows to maximize impact on key domains areas of biomedical research that will potentially lead to developing better drugs, faster.

Job Description
Step into a pivotal leadership role at the forefront of scientific innovation, where cutting-edge artificial intelligence meets biomedical research. As Director & Group Head (Applied AI), you will shape how advanced machine learning approaches accelerate drug discovery, translating complex data into meaningful scientific insights that can transform patient outcomes. You will lead high-impact collaborations, guide strategic AI direction across research domains, and empower teams to push the boundaries of what is possible in developing better medicines, faster.

Key Responsibilities

• Define and lead the applied artificial intelligence strategy and multi-year roadmap across drug discovery research.

• Align priorities with portfolio needs, scientific opportunities, and measurable business and research impact.

• Lead multidisciplinary teams to identify, prototype, benchmark, and deploy fit-for-purpose artificial intelligence solutions.

• Govern an applied artificial intelligence portfolio with clear intake, prioritization, resourcing, delivery oversight, and success metrics.

• Establish best practices for problem framing, data readiness, benchmarking, evaluation design, and reproducible model development.

• Drive benchmarking of foundation and task-specific models, enabling transparent trade-offs and informed adoption decisions.

• Partner with engineering teams to scale solutions and embed them into day-to-day scientific decision making.

• Define rigorous evaluation metrics linking model performance to downstream decisions and experimental outcomes.

• Build a culture of scientific rigor, rapid iteration, mentorship, and practical impact across teams.

• Forge strategic academic and industry collaborations to accelerate innovation, benchmarking, and technology transfer.

Essential Requirements

• Demonstrated experience in leading core machine learning capability development initiatives across drug discovery teams and use cases.

• Proven experience with foundation model benchmarking in drug discovery applications.

• Hands-on experience applying machine learning

descriptionByLocale.it:
Gamma di insalata: CHF1,46,300.00 - CHF2,71,700.00 Descrizione del lavoro Titolo del lavoro: Direttore & Group Head (Applied AI) #LI-Hybrid # Ubicazione: Basilea, Svizzera Supporto di trasferimento: Questo ruolo è basato a Basilea, Svizzera. Novartis non è in grado di offrire il supporto di trasferimento: si prega di applicare solo se accessibile. Novartis ha abbracciato una strategia coraggiosa per guidare una trasformazione digitale a livello aziendale. Il nostro obiettivo è quello di posizionare Novartis come leader del settore adottando proattivamente tecnologie digitali che favoriscono approcci innovativi per accelerare la scoperta e lo sviluppo della droga. Utilizzando dati R&D interni ed esterni con la potenza della scienza dei dati, modelli predittivi, AI generativo e machine learning, il nostro obiettivo è quello di identificare nuovi obiettivi, creare molecole terapeutiche più efficaci, prevedere meglio farmacocinetica e rischi di sicurezza, perfezionare il design di prova clinica e ridurre significativamente i cicli di sviluppo. Il team AI4R conduce BR nell'esplorazione e nell'applicazione di metodologie AI e ML avanzate per generare nuove intuizioni di scoperta della droga, e per accelerare e migliorare l'efficienza della scoperta della droga, concentrandosi sulle esigenze dei pazienti. I partner AI4R con i team di scoperta della droga, aumentano il livello di esperienza AI in Biomedical Research (BR) e assicurano che la scienza BR continui con l'ecosistema in rapida evoluzione delle tecnologie AI collegandosi con i leader dell'IA in accademia e industria. Questo ruolo di leadership per il gruppo AI Applicato di AI4R sarà affidato a una forte leadership tecnica, di squadra e di progetto, allineando con gli esperti di materia biomedica per comprendere profondamente le opportunità ML nella scoperta della droga, valutazione del paesaggio del modello, benchmarking del modello di leader, e applicando i giusti approcci AI, algoritmi, modelli e flussi di lavoro per massimizzare l'impatto sulle aree chiave di ricerca biomedica che potenzialmente porteranno a sviluppare farmaci migliori, più velocemente. Descrizione del lavoro Entra in un ruolo di leadership fondamentale all'avanguardia nell'innovazione scientifica, dove l'intelligenza artificiale all'avanguardia incontra la ricerca biomedica. In qualità di Direttore & Group Head (Applied AI), formerai come approcci avanzati di machine learning accelerano la scoperta dei farmaci, traducendo dati complessi in approfondimenti scientifici significativi che possono trasformare i risultati dei pazienti. Potrai condurre collaborazioni ad alto impatto, guidare la direzione strategica AI attraverso i domini di ricerca, e rafforzare i team di spingere i confini di ciò che è possibile nello sviluppo di farmaci migliori, più veloce. Principali responsabilità
• Definire e guidare la strategia di intelligenza artificiale applicata e roadmap pluriennale attraverso la ricerca di scoperta della droga.
• Allineare le priorità con le esigenze del portafoglio, le opportunità scientifiche e l'impatto commerciale e di ricerca misurabile.
• Leader team multidisciplinari per identificare, prototipo, benchmark e distribuire soluzioni di intelligenza artificiale fit-for-purpose.
• Governare un portafoglio di intelligenza artificiale applicato con l'assunzione chiara, la priorità, la risonanza, la supervisione della consegna e le metriche di successo.
• Stabilire le migliori pratiche per la definizione dei problemi, la disponibilità dei dati, il benchmarking, la progettazione della valutazione e lo sviluppo del modello riproducibile.
• Promuovere il benchmarking delle fondazioni e dei modelli specifici per le attività, consentendo scambi trasparenti e decisioni di adozione informate.
• Collaborare con i team di ingegneria per scalare le soluzioni e incorporarle nel processo decisionale scientifico quotidiano.
• Definire metriche di valutazione rigorose che collegano le prestazioni del modello a decisioni a valle e risultati sperimentali.
• Costruire una cultura del rigore scientifico, rapida iterazione, mentorship e impatto pratico tra le squadre.
• Forge collaborazioni accademiche e industriali strategiche per accelerare innovazione, benchmarking e trasferimento tecnologico. Requisiti essenziali
• Esperienza dimostrata nelle principali iniziative di sviluppo delle capacità di apprendimento delle macchine principali tra i team di scoperta della droga e casi di utilizzo.
• Esperienza dimostrata con il modello di base benchmarking nelle applicazioni di scoperta della droga.
• Esperienza pratica sull'applicazione dell'apprendimento automatico

Gehaltsbereich: CHF1,46,300.00 - CHF2,71,700.00 Stellenbeschreibung Zusammenfassung Berufsbezeichnung: Director & Group Head (Applied AI) #LI-Hybrid Standort: Basel, Schweiz Relocation Support: Diese Rolle hat ihren Sitz in Basel, Schweiz. Novartis kann keine Umzugsunterstützung anbieten: Bitte bewerben Sie sich nur, wenn Sie erreichbar sind. Novartis hat eine mutige Strategie verfolgt, um eine unternehmensweite digitale Transformation voranzutreiben. Unser Ziel ist es, Novartis als Branchenführer zu positionieren, indem wir proaktiv digitale Technologien einsetzen, die innovative Ansätze zur Beschleunigung der Wirkstoffforschung und -entwicklung fördern. Durch die Nutzung sowohl interner als auch externer F & E-Daten mit der Leistungsfähigkeit von Data Science, prädiktiven Modellen, generativer KI und maschinellem Lernen ist es unser Ziel, neue Ziele zu identifizieren, effektivere therapeutische Moleküle zu erstellen, Arzneimittelpharmakokinetik und Sicherheitsrisiken besser vorherzusagen, das Design klinischer Studien zu verfeinern und Entwicklungszyklen deutlich zu verkürzen. Das AI4R-Team leitet BR bei der Erforschung und Anwendung fortschrittlicher KI- und ML-Methoden, um neue Erkenntnisse in der Wirkstoffforschung zu generieren und die Effizienz der Wirkstoffforschung zu beschleunigen und zu verbessern, während es sich auf die Bedürfnisse der Patienten konzentriert. AI4R arbeitet mit Wirkstoffforschungsteams zusammen, erhöht das Niveau der KI-Expertise in der biomedizinischen Forschung (BR) und stellt sicher, dass die BR-Wissenschaft mit dem sich schnell entwickelnden Ökosystem der KI-Technologien Schritt hält, indem sie sich mit KI-Führungskräften in Wissenschaft und Industrie verbindet. Diese Führungsrolle für die Applied AI-Gruppe von AI4R wird mit einer starken technischen, Team- und Projektführung beauftragt, die sich mit biomedizinischen Fachexperten zusammensetzt, um die ML-Möglichkeiten in der Wirkstoffforschung, der Bewertung der Modelllandschaft, der Leitung des Modell-Benchmarkings und der Anwendung der richtigen KI-Ansätze, Algorithmen, Modelle und Workflows zu verstehen und die Auswirkungen auf wichtige Bereiche der biomedizinischen Forschung zu maximieren, die möglicherweise dazu führen werden Entwicklung besserer Medikamente, schneller. Stellenbeschreibung Treten Sie in eine zentrale Führungsrolle an der Spitze der wissenschaftlichen Innovation ein, wo innovative künstliche Intelligenz auf biomedizinische Forschung trifft. Als Director & Group Head (Applied AI) gestalten Sie, wie fortschrittliche maschinelle Lernansätze die Wirkstoffforschung beschleunigen und komplexe Daten in sinnvolle wissenschaftliche Erkenntnisse übersetzen, die die Patientenergebnisse verändern können. Sie werden einflussreiche Kooperationen leiten, die strategische KI-Richtung über Forschungsbereiche hinweg lenken und Teams befähigen, die Grenzen dessen, was bei der Entwicklung besserer Medikamente möglich ist, schneller zu überschreiten. Wichtigste Zuständigkeiten
• Definieren und leiten Sie die angewandte Strategie für künstliche Intelligenz und die mehrjährige Roadmap für die Wirkstoffforschung.
• Ausrichtung der Prioritäten auf Portfolioanforderungen, wissenschaftliche Möglichkeiten und messbare Auswirkungen auf Unternehmen und Forschung.
• Führen Sie multidisziplinäre Teams an, um Lösungen für künstliche Intelligenz zu identifizieren, zu entwickeln, zu vergleichen und einzusetzen.
• Leiten Sie ein Portfolio für angewandte künstliche Intelligenz mit klaren Annahme-, Priorisierungs-, Resourcing-, Lieferaufsichts- und Erfolgsmetriken.
• Etablieren Sie Best Practices für Problemrahmen, Datenbereitschaft, Benchmarking, Bewertungsdesign und reproduzierbare Modellentwicklung.
• Förderung des Benchmarkings von Stiftungs- und aufgabenspezifischen Modellen, um transparente Kompromisse und fundierte Adoptionsentscheidungen zu ermöglichen.
• Zusammenarbeit mit Ingenieurteams, um Lösungen zu skalieren und sie in die tägliche wissenschaftliche Entscheidungsfindung einzubetten.
• Definieren Sie strenge Bewertungsmetriken, die die Modellleistung mit nachgelagerten Entscheidungen und experimentellen Ergebnissen verbinden.
• Bauen Sie eine Kultur der wissenschaftlichen Strenge, schnellen Iteration, Mentoring und praktischen Auswirkungen in allen Teams auf.
• Schmieden Sie strategische akademische und industrielle Kooperationen, um Innovation, Benchmarking und Technologietransfer zu beschleunigen. Grundlegende Anforderungen
• Nachgewiesene Erfahrung in führenden Kernentwicklungsinitiativen für maschinelles Lernen in Wirkstoffforschungsteams und Anwendungsfällen.
• Nachgewiesene Erfahrung mit Foundation Model Benchmarking in Wirkstoffforschungsanwendungen.
• Hands-on-Erfahrung mit maschinellem Lernen
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Échelle salariale : 1 46 300,00 CHF - 2 71 700,00 CHF Résumé de la description d'emploi Titre du poste: Directeur et chef de groupe (IA appliquée) #LI-Hybrid Lieu: Bâle, Suisse Soutien à la réinstallation: Ce rôle est basé à Bâle, en Suisse. Novartis n'est pas en mesure d'offrir une aide à la réinstallation : veuillez soumettre une demande seulement si elle est accessible. Novartis a adopté une stratégie audacieuse pour conduire une transformation numérique à l'échelle de l'entreprise. Notre objectif est de positionner Novartis comme un leader de l'industrie en adoptant proactivement des technologies numériques qui favorisent des approches novatrices pour accélérer la découverte et le développement de médicaments. En utilisant les données internes et externes de R-D avec la puissance de la science des données, des modèles prédictifs, de l'IA générative et de l'apprentissage machine, notre objectif est d'identifier de nouvelles cibles, de créer des molécules thérapeutiques plus efficaces, de mieux prédire la pharmacocinétique des médicaments et les risques pour la sécurité, d'affiner la conception des essais cliniques et de raccourcir considérablement les cycles de développement. L'équipe de l'IA4R dirige BR dans l'exploration et l'application de méthodologies avancées d'IA et de ML pour générer de nouvelles idées de découverte de médicaments, et pour accélérer et améliorer l'efficacité de la découverte de médicaments tout en se concentrant sur les besoins des patients. L'IA4R s'associe à des équipes de découverte de médicaments, augmente le niveau d'expertise de l'IA dans l'ensemble de la recherche biomédicale (BR) et veille à ce que la science de l'IA continue de s'adapter à l'écosystème en évolution rapide des technologies de l'IA en se connectant aux leaders de l'IA dans les milieux universitaires et industriels. Ce rôle de chef de file pour le groupe AI4R appliqué sera chargé d'assurer un solide leadership technique, d'équipe et de projet, en s' alignant avec les experts en matière biomédicale pour bien comprendre les possibilités de ML dans la découverte de médicaments, l'évaluation du paysage du modèle, l'analyse comparative des modèles et l'application des approches, algorithmes, modèles et flux de travail appropriés en matière d'IA afin de maximiser l'impact sur les domaines clés de la recherche biomédicale qui pourraient mener à la mise au point de meilleurs médicaments, plus rapidement. Description de l'emploi Entrez dans un rôle de leadership central à l'avant-garde de l'innovation scientifique, où l'intelligence artificielle de pointe rencontre la recherche biomédicale. En tant que directeur et chef de groupe (IA appliquée), vous déterminerez comment l'apprentissage automatique avancé s'approche pour accélérer la découverte de médicaments, transformant des données complexes en données scientifiques significatives qui peuvent transformer les résultats des patients. Vous dirigerez des collaborations à impact élevé, guiderez l'orientation stratégique de l'IA dans tous les domaines de recherche et permettreez aux équipes de repousser les limites de ce qui est possible pour développer de meilleurs médicaments, plus rapidement. Principales responsabilités
• Définir et diriger la stratégie d'intelligence artificielle appliquée et la feuille de route pluriannuelle pour la recherche sur la découverte de médicaments.
• Harmoniser les priorités avec les besoins du portefeuille, les possibilités scientifiques et l'impact mesurable des activités et de la recherche.
• Diriger des équipes multidisciplinaires pour identifier, prototyper, comparer et déployer des solutions d'intelligence artificielle adaptées à l'usage.
• Gouvernance d'un portefeuille de renseignements artificiels appliqués comportant des données d'entrée, de priorité, de ressourcement, de surveillance de l'exécution et de mesure du succès.
• Établir des pratiques exemplaires pour l'élaboration des problèmes, la préparation aux données, l'analyse comparative, la conception de l'évaluation et l'élaboration de modèles reproductibles.
• Diriger l'analyse comparative des modèles de base et des modèles spécifiques aux tâches, en permettant des compromis transparents et des décisions d'adoption éclairées.
• Partenaire avec des équipes d'ingénierie pour mettre à l'échelle les solutions et les intégrer dans la prise de décision scientifique quotidienne.
• Définir des mesures d'évaluation rigoureuses reliant le rendement du modèle aux décisions en aval et aux résultats expérimentaux.
• Construire une culture de rigueur scientifique, d'itération rapide, de mentorat et d'impact pratique entre les équipes.
• Forger des collaborations stratégiques entre les universités et l'industrie pour accélérer l'innovation, l'étalonnage et le transfert de technologie. Exigences essentielles
• Expérience démontrée dans la conduite d'initiatives de développement de la capacité d'apprentissage automatique au sein des équipes de découverte de médicaments et des cas d'utilisation.
• Expérience éprouvée de l'analyse comparative des modèles de base dans les applications de découverte de médicaments.
• Expérience pratique en appliquant l'apprentissage automatique

Job Description Summary
#LI-Hybrid

Location: Basel, Switzerland

Step into a pivotal role where your leadership can directly shape how breakthrough cardiovascular innovations reach patients worldwide.

International Value & Access Director - Cardio Pipeline, you will set a bold strategic direction, transforming scientific advances into clear, compelling value for payers and healthcare systems. You’ll inspire and unite cross‑functional and country teams, championing access solutions that accelerate affordability, broaden impact, and redefine what’s possible for patients and health systems.

Here, your vision, influence, and enterprise mindset will help build an integrated access strategy that truly moves the needle — for Novartis, for partners, and most importantly, for the people we serve.

This position reports into the Executive Director, V&A CRM.

Job Description
Key Responsibilities:

• Lead creation and execution of integrated international access strategies across the full development‑to‑commercial continuum.

• Shape compelling payer and healthcare‑system value propositions grounded in strong scientific and access‑relevant evidence.

• Represent Access internally and externally, influencing strategic discussions and strengthening Novartis’ international access agenda.

• Embed access insights into Target Product Profiles, clinical plans, and integrated evidence plans to guide asset decision‑making.

• Partner with Commercial Launch Strategy, Pricing, and Therapeutic Areas to co‑create robust international pricing strategies and guidance.

• Ensure timely, high‑quality access input into Integrated Product Strategy, business development assessments, and indication sequencing.

• Collaborate with Health Economics and cross‑franchise teams to align evidence priorities with key market needs.

• Anticipate shifts in priority markets and health‑technology‑assessment archetypes to model future access assumptions and recommendations.

• Build strong cross‑functional and external partnerships to enable innovative, scalable access solutions.

• Champion an enterprise approach, connecting countries and functions to deliver consistent, high‑impact access strategies.

Essential Requirements:

• 5+ years of experience in market access roles, including 2+ years global or ex-US regional experience.

• CRM product launch experience.

• 2+ years of experience in the relevant therapeutic area.

• Cross functional leadership experience across matrix organization.

• Strong communication skills and ability to influence across a range of diverse stakeholders to drive change.

• Competitive and entrepreneurial mindset with proven track record of fostering innovation.

Desirable Requirements:

• 7+ years of experience in market access roles, including 5+ years global or ex-US regional experience.

• Strong external network with thought leaders and influencers in the payer and HTA environment.

Accessibility and accommodation

• Technisches Verständnis sowie Fähigkeit, selbstständig und zuverlässig nach Vorgaben zu arbeiten

• Erfahrung mit Prozessleitsystemen, idealerweise DeltaV (Emerson) oder Siemens Steuerungssysteme

• Sorgfältige, strukturierte und qualitätsbewusste Arbeitsweise mit hoher Eigenverantwortung

Job Description Summary
#LI-Hybrid
Location: Basel, Switzerland or Cambridge, United States (see separate posting)

Ready to shape the future of innovation at Novartis? As a Patent Attorney, you will play a pivotal role in protecting groundbreaking scientific discoveries and enabling life-changing medicines to reach patients worldwide. Partnering closely with R&D teams, you will drive strategic intellectual property decisions, build robust patent portfolios, and navigate complex legal landscapes to safeguard innovation across the product lifecycle.

Job Description
Key Responsibilities

• Provide clear, strategic, and business-focused counsel to Novartis R&D clients on invention protection, portfolio development, publication strategy, and third-party risks.

• Build and manage patent portfolios for Novartis R&D projects by identifying inventions and preparing, prosecuting, maintaining, and defending patent filings across areas such as new molecular entities, processes, manufacturing, platforms, technologies, and clinical developments.

• Render legal opinions on patentability, validity, and freedom to operate, and develop patent strategies that strengthen IP positions, support freedom to operate, and enable effective IP defense.

• Apply deep knowledge of national patent law and practice, including relevant legal developments and patent trends, to shape strategy and advice.

• Understand and apply other forms of exclusivity protection, as appropriate.

• Communicate effectively with colleagues and leaders across the legal, IP, and R&D organizations.

• Build and manage relationships with outside counsel and collaborators, including extensive interaction within a multicultural global patent function.

• Conduct due diligence and provide counsel based on those assessments, including freedom-to-operate, infringement, validity, risk evaluation, and risk mitigation strategies.

• Provide IP support for transactional matters, including M&A, research collaborations, and in-licensing opportunities, with advice on contract drafting and negotiation

• Ensure high-quality, timely delivery of work aligned with business goals and budgets

Essential Requirements

• University degree in law, admission to the bar and qualification as a European Patent Attorney / Lawyer

• Advanced degree in chemistry or related field, with strong preference for a doctoral degree

• Significant experience as a patent attorney within a law firm or pharmaceutical or biotechnology environment

• Strong technical expertise in chemistry, preferably including experience with small molecules, synthesis, or pharmaceutical development.

• Expertise in U.S. and PCT patent law, filing processes, and prosecution practice, with a detailed understanding of European patent law and other major global patent systems

• Proven ability to partner with scientific and business stakeholders to deliver strategic intellectual property advice

• Strong analytical, communication, and decision-making skills with high attention to detail

• Ability to manage multiple priorities effectively within a fast-paced, global environment

Benefits & Rewards

At Novartis, we’re committed to reimagining medicine together - and rewarding the people who make it happen.

Expected Annual Base Salary Range for role: CHF 146.300 - CHF 271.700

The base salary offered is determined based on gender-neutral objectives, such as relevant skills, competencies and experience in accordance with the Novartis pay setting policy and upon joining Novartis will be reviewed periodically.

The rewards of being part of our team go far beyond base pay and incentives. We also offer a variety of competitive benefits in kind to help you thrive personally and professionally, such as insurance plans, retirement plans, wellbeing resources and global recognition programs. In addition, we provide flexible and hybrid working options, where possible, and minimum 14 weeks paid parental l

En tant qu'avocat en brevets, vous jouerez un rôle central dans la protection des découvertes scientifiques révolutionnaires et dans l'accès aux médicaments qui changent la vie des patients dans le monde entier. En étroite collaboration avec les équipes de R-D, vous dirigerez les décisions stratégiques en matière de propriété intellectuelle, créerez de solides portefeuilles de brevets et naviguerez dans des paysages juridiques complexes pour préserver l'innovation tout au long du cycle de vie des produits. Description de l'emploi Principales responsabilités
• Fournir des conseils clairs, stratégiques et axés sur les affaires aux clients de la R-D de Novartis sur la protection des inventions, l'élaboration de portefeuilles, la stratégie de publication et les risques pour les tiers.
• Créer et gérer des portefeuilles de brevets pour les projets de R-D de Novartis en identifiant les inventions et en préparant, poursuivant, maintenant et défendant les dépôts de brevets dans des domaines tels que les nouvelles entités moléculaires, les processus, la fabrication, les plates-formes, les technologies et les développements cliniques.
• Rendre des avis juridiques sur la brevetabilité, la validité et la liberté de fonctionner, et élaborer des stratégies de brevets qui renforcent les positions en matière de propriété intellectuelle, soutiennent la liberté de fonctionner et permettent une défense efficace de la propriété intellectuelle.

• Effectuer une diligence raisonnable et fournir des conseils fondés sur ces évaluations, y compris la liberté de fonctionner, la violation, la validité, l'évaluation des risques et les stratégies d'atténuation des risques.
• Fournir un soutien en matière de propriété intellectuelle pour les questions transactionnelles, y compris les fusions-acquisitions, les collaborations en recherche et les possibilités de licence, en fournissant des conseils sur la rédaction et la négociation de contrats

jobs.description:
Job Description Summary
This position can be based remotely anywhere in the U.S. Please note that this role would not provide relocation as a result. The expectation of working hours and travel (domestic and/or international) will be defined by the Hiring Manager.

Job Description
The Strategy, Platforms & Transformation t eam is dedicated to enabling improved decision-making at Novartis by leveraging data and advanced analytics capabilities to generate actionable insights that drive business growth. We work within the US business, bringing insights and challenging ideas to empower smarter, data-driven decision-making. This role is crucial in driving AI transformation by bringing the best in AI and tech to unlock opportunities for growth and improve patient outcomes.

The Executive Director, AI Foundations Engineering Lead will lead the engineering strategy, delivery, and operational excellence for the organization’s agentic AI operating system, with responsibility spanning solution architecture, development, operations, and continuous improvement. This role will be central to enabling the transformation of existing processes, products, and services into agentic AI products and intelligent workflows by providing a scalable, secure, and high performing foundation. The ideal candidate will bring deep engineering leadership, systems thinking, and technical vision to guide the design and evolution of core agentic capabilities, establish engineering standards and operating models, and lead cross functional teams in delivering resilient and extensible AI services. Working closely with product leaders, business stakeholders, data and technology teams, and transformation leaders, this role will ensure the agentic systems accelerate innovation, support enterprise adoption, and delivers measurable business value through reliable and scalable execution.

Major Accountabilities:

• Define and lead the engineering strategy, roadmap, and operating model for our organization’s agentic AI platform.

• Oversee the design, development, integration, deployment, and ongoing operation of foundational capabilities that support agentic AI products and workflows.

• Establish platform engineering standards, architectural principles, and development practices to ensure scalability, reliability, security, and maintainability.

• Lead cross functional engineering teams in building reusable platform services, tools, and components that accelerate product delivery and adoption.

• Partner with product, data, infrastructure, security, and business teams to align platform capabilities with enterprise priorities and evolving user needs.

• Drive platform performance, operational excellence, and continuous improvement through monitoring, feedback loops, incident review, and service optimization.

• Guide the modernization of existing systems and processes to enable integration with agentic AI products, workflows, and platform services.

• Communicate agentic AI strategy, technical direction, delivery progress, risks, and investment needs to senior executives and key stakeholders.

Essential Requirements:

• A minimum of a bachelor's degree in related field is required; Master of Science and/or MBA strongly preferred

• 15 plus years of progressive product management experience, including significant leadership over senior product leaders, with a strong track record of defining and scaling enterprise level product strategy and execution.

• Deep expertise in AI driven product management, including experience bringing innovative data, machine learning, and generative AI products from concept to commercialization in complex enterprise environments.

• Proven people leadership and organizational development capability, with experience leading directors and senior product teams, building high performing organizations, and establishing effective product operating models and governance.

• Strong cross functional and executive influence skills, with demonstrated suc

jobs.title: Senior Principal Scientist - Proteomics
jobs.description:
Salary Range:
CHF126,000.00 - CHF234,000.00

Job Description Summary
We are looking for an enthusiastic, curious, and highly motivated proteomics expert to join our Discovery Sciences Translational Profiling (TP) team in Basel. TP is a global group of experts in proteomics, metabolomics, lipidomics, super-resolution microscopy, and data science, within Novartis Biomedical Research at our sites in Basel, Switzerland and Cambridge, US.
As a Senior Principal Scientist, you will lead a proteomics lab team, play a pivotal role in advancing our cutting-edge technologies and contribute to our global proteomics strategy.
